name: Marcus T.
text: Finally someone calling out the sketchy bots. I wasted three months on that one bot that promised 40% returns monthly - turned out it was just overleveraging on micro caps. Glad I found Freqtrade, actually open source and transparent.

name: Sarah K.
text: The ccxt integration section was super helpful. Question though: does anyone here actually trade with bots on live accounts or do you mostly backtest? Seems risky but curious what the community does.

name: Devon P.
text: Been running CPBB for 6 months now and honestly the performance beats my manual trading by a mile. The learning curve is steep but worth it if you actually understand your strategy parameters.

name: Lisa R.
text: I disagree with skipping PyAlgoTrade. Sure it's older but it's rock solid for backtesting and the documentation is clearer than most modern alternatives.

name: James H.
text: The point about API rate limits was clutch. Lost money last week because my bot kept hitting exchange limits and missing trades. Definitely audit that before going live.
